payout_value_note: Flat $50 to the referrer and $50 to the friend. Referrer capped at $500 per calendar year.
payout_quote: $50/$50 Refer-A-Friend Checking Account Promotion Period: January 5 - December 31, 2026 ... By making a valid referral that results in a qualified new account opening during the Promotion Period, you will receive $50 ... the friend will receive $50.
steps: Referrer must be a US resident 18+ with an active Midland States Bank personal checking account (Liv Simply/Unlimited/Rewarded, Totally Free, Direct Interest, 50+ Interest, or High Yield) in good standing.
Referrer generates a unique Personal Link at refer.midlandsb.com and shares it personally with friends/family/colleagues.
Friend opens a new eligible personal checking account via the link within 30 calendar days of receiving it (before the promotion ends).
Friend's account must stay open and active for at least 90 calendar days in good standing.
$50 deposited to each party within 30 business days of qualifications being met (no later than 120 days from account opening).
catches: Referrer cap: $500 total per calendar year across all Midland referral programs.
Friend must open within 30 days of receiving the link and keep the account open 90 days — payout can take up to 120 days from account opening.
Publication of the offer on 3rd-party sites is prohibited; bulk email/stranger solicitation prohibited.
Referrer's $50 may be reported on 1099-MISC; friend's on 1099-INT.
Friend cannot have closed a Midland personal account within the prior 90 days.
Bank may delay/refuse rewards for investigation; decisions final and binding.
biggest_catch: Capped at $500/year, and the friend must keep the account open 90 days — the $50 can arrive up to 120 days after the account is opened.
eligibility: Midland States Bank personal checking customer 18+; friend must be new to Midland personal checking.
timing: Link sharing ~5 min active; $50 within 30 business days after the 90-day qualification (up to 120 days from opening).
